build_TorqueStanceLegController: build a TorqueStanceLegController instance with robot, gait generator, and state estimator for quadruped torque control
get_action_compute_torques: get the joint torque actions for stance legs by calling get_action on the controller
reset_controller_state: reset the TorqueStanceLegController QP solver fail flag and COM estimate leg indices at a given time
configure_desired_speed: configure the desired CoM walking speed in the x-y plane via the desired_speed property setter
review_MPC_weights: review the MPC QP weights tuple used for tracking the desired center of mass trajectory
